_classes.name: Entitlements ('shall receive', 'shall be entitled to', 'shall be given full credit', 'placed in grade') stored as duties - known class, recurrence
_classes.rule: kind=='duty' and re.search(r"\bshall (continue to )?receive\b|\bshall be entitled to\b|\bshall be given (full )?credit\b|\bshall be placed in his or her grade\b", quote, re.I)
_classes.note: benefit_entitlement gate dropped the 'shall be increased' variants in 2013-S7845 but not the 'shall receive' variants

_classes.name: Passive payment mechanics / schedule content stored as duties (withheld pay 'shall thereafter be paid', 'shall be reduced', 'shall be made as soon as practicable', 'there shall be no longevity rates')
_classes.rule: indicative only: kind=='duty' and quote matches r'shall (thereafter )?be (paid|made|reduced)\b' with no government noun before 'shall'; noisy

_classes.name: same_as_chapter referencing 'Part X' of an omnibus chapter resolved to the referenced chapter's act-level date instead of Part X's own clause
_classes.rule: effective_dates: rule=='same_as_chapter' and re.search(r'same manner (as )?part [A-Z]+\b', raw_clause, re.I) and the referenced chapter_index raw_clause mentions 'parts' and effective_date == reference.effective_date

_classes.name: expires_rule with_referenced_section set when the act's own clause has no 'therewith' (picked up from amended earlier-chapter text)
_classes.rule: effective_dates: expires_rule=='with_referenced_section' and 'therewith' not in raw_clause

_classes.name: Raised bond/note amount cap stored as duty; Kind ruling (Nov 12) makes a raised cap a power with extends_existing true (conflicts with packet rule 'bond cap ... is a duty' - needs orchestrator ruling)
_classes.rule: kind=='duty' and extends_existing and re.search(r'aggregate principal amount (exceeding|not to exceed|of not more than)', quote, re.I)

_classes.name: One-time special-act exemption powers (accept/grant/refund for named parcel and rolls) given recurrence 'ongoing'
_classes.rule: kind=='power' and re.search(r'authorized to accept.{0,120}application', quote, re.I) and recurrence=='ongoing' (sibling grant/refund powers of the same law follow)

_classes.name: Citation-only correction ('[chapter] {{article}}') stored as its own record, duplicating the substantive record for the same provision
_classes.rule: no mechanical rule (requires comparing braced span to deleted span)
